title: sse: fix partial JSON delimiter and token/event ordering in streaming framing
author: Avery Chen
title_short: sse streaming framing partial json delimiter fix
description: Fixes multiple issues in the SSE streaming framer that caused partial JSON payloads and delimiter tokens to be emitted in the wrong order during reconnects and when chunk boundaries split JSON tokens. This PR unblocks several customer-facing stability problems in the OpenAI-compat streaming layer and prevents downstream parsers from seeing malformed partial-json events. Changes include: 1) stricter framing state machine that tracks partial-json depth and ensures delimiting events ("event: close", "data: [..]") are emitted only after a partial token is complete; 2) reordering logic to ensure token events are emitted in the original generation order across reconnects and multi-chunk messages; 3) additional buffering for KV-cache-driven delta frames to avoid splitting JSON tokens across SSE chunks; 4) compatibility fixes for the openai-compat streaming shim so tool/function-calling JSON blobs are always emitted atomically; 5) tests reproducing the original failure modes and new unit/integration checks. Checklist: - [x] reproduce failure in test harness - [x] fix framing logic - [x] add unit tests and integration test with simulated reconnect - [x] update docs/breaking notes - [x] run perf regression bench. This description includes references to Linear ENG-4123 and SUP-887 for context. The description is intentionally a single continuous string.
